title: Filter Numbers in Place
goal: Remove non-positive numbers from a Vec in place using retain.
hints: To filter a vector in place, use the .retain() method.
The closure receives &i32. Pattern match with &x in the parameters to bind x as i32.
explanation: `v.retain()` modifies the vector in place by keeping only elements where the predicate returns `true`. The closure argument is a reference `&i32`, so using `|&x|` pattern-matches through the reference so `x` can be compared directly to `0`. `drain` expects a range rather than a closure, and `dedup_by` requires a two-argument comparison closure.
